profile.headline: Backend Software Engineer | Cloud | AI
profile.summary:
I'm a Backend-focused Software Engineer with experience building scalable APIs, cloud-based applications, and enterprise systems.
 
My background includes backend development, REST APIs, database-driven applications, security, and cloud architecture. I've worked on enterprise systems at Daytona State College, digital banking solutions during my internship at IBM, and backend services for an Early Warning System in Colombia.
 
I'm also interested in the intersection of Backend Engineering, Cloud, and Artificial Intelligence. Through projects such as ActivLingo, I've built AI-powered applications integrating conversational AI, speech processing, authentication, and scalable backend services.
 
I'm AWS Solutions Architect Associate and AWS Developer Associate certified, and I'm currently pursuing an M.S. in Computer Engineering at the University of Central Florida.
 
Focus: Backend Development • Cloud Computing • AWS • REST APIs • Artificial Intelligence

positions.description: Lead Backend Developer for the Caldas Department's Early Warning System (EWS), partnered with the National University of Colombia. Expert in leveraging technologies like Laravel, PostgreSQL, and more to drive innovation and efficiency.

projects.title: Activlingo
projects.description: Activlingo is an AI-powered English learning platform designed to help users improve their speaking, listening, and conversational skills through interactive practice. I designed and developed the platform as a full-stack project, working across the frontend, backend, database, cloud infrastructure, and AI integrations. The project focuses on creating immersive, personalized learning experiences while maintaining scalable, secure, and maintainable software architecture.

projects.title: AventuraT
projects.description: AventuraT es una pagina web la cual ofrece servicio de turismo y productos para la aventura, junto con paquetes a sitios turísticos de Colombia, con panel de usuarios, pestañas, navegación y todo tipo de componentes
